name: fovea
description: FOVEA - Flexible Ontology Visual Event Analyzer

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm run dev:services
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.dev:infra:full: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis otel-collector jaeger prometheus grafana
scripts.build: pnpm run --filter @fovea/annotation-tool build && pnpm run --filter @fovea/server build
scripts.test: pnpm run --filter @fovea/annotation-tool test -- --run && pnpm run --filter @fovea/server test -- --run
scripts.lint: pnpm run --filter @fovea/annotation-tool lint && pnpm run --filter @fovea/server lint
